decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - That the London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby acknowledge the 28 day notification period and certify that on 7 March 2005 the proposed exchange of 3x existing antennae with 3x UK Broadband antennae of the same size and scale was lawful within the meaning of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 and planning permission was not required for the following reason:

The proposed development falls within the provisions given in Class A of Schedule 2, Part 24 of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995, "the installation, alteration or replacement of any telecommunication apparatus".  It would be sited, so far as practicable, to minimise its effect on the external appearance of the building in accordance with Condition A.2(1) and does not require prior approval under Condition A.2(4).
description: Exchange of 3 X existing antennae with 3 X UK broad brand antennae of the same size and scale.
